value.rationale: Quantifies the exact affine-invariant Santaló volume-product response along the canonical recently studied interpolation between Steiner symmetrization and shaking. This is not merely a fixed-center or unchanged-volume computation: the Santaló point shifts by a nontrivial sharp coefficient, and the quadratic deficit \(32/3-\pi^2\) and cubic center-versus-centroid displacement are unavailable from general qualitative convexity alone. Provides an exact all-parameter disk baseline including the nonsmooth shaking limit; does not claim a general theorem for other bodies.
